dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open problem on $\eta$-boundedness for disjoint union of two stars
dossier_meta.statement_text: It remains open whether the disjoint union of two stars satisfies Conjecture 1.8, i.e., whether the class of $(S_{a}\cup S_{b})$-free graphs is $\eta$-bounded for all $a,b\geq 1$.
dossier_meta.context_text: For the Gyárfás–Sumner conjecture, $\chi$-boundedness of an $H$-free class reduces to $\chi$-boundedness of the component-free classes. The authors do not know whether the analogous reduction holds for Conjecture 1.8, and in particular whether the disjoint union of two stars satisfies $\eta$-boundedness.
